title: Japanese Sesame Pickled Cucumber
summary: A crisp, tangy Japanese-style cucumber snack dressed with rice vinegar, sesame oil and toasted sesame seeds. It is quick to make and best after a short chill, when the cucumber is lightly pickled but still crunchy.
steps: Put the sliced cucumber in a bowl with the salt and toss well. Leave for 10 minutes until the cucumber softens slightly and releases a little liquid.
Toast the sesame seeds in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes, shaking the pan, until lightly golden and fragrant. Tip onto a plate to cool.
Drain off the cucumber liquid and gently squeeze the slices with clean hands to remove excess moisture without crushing them.
In a bowl, stir together the rice vinegar, sugar and sesame oil until the sugar dissolves.
Add the cucumber and spring onion to the dressing and toss until evenly coated. Chill for 20 minutes so the cucumber lightly pickles.
Sprinkle with the toasted sesame seeds just before serving, and toss once more.
